title: Compare Strings by Frequency of the Smallest Character
description: Count how many words have a frequency of their smallest character greater than that of a query string.
pseudocode:
1. Calculate f(s) for all words -> wordFreqs
2. Sort wordFreqs
3. For each query q:
4.   target = f(q)
5.   count = count elements in wordFreqs > target
6. Return results

steps.note: Calculate f('zaaaz'). Smallest char is 'a', occurs 3 times. f('zaaaz') = 3.
Processing query 'cbd'. Smallest char is 'b', occurs 1 time. f('cbd') = 1.
Compare f('cbd') = 1 with wordFreqs [3]. Since 1 < 3, count is 1.
